svg.title: Beretta system: component diagram
svg.text: Beretta: component view of the three subsystems and how they connect
Read-only by design. Never collects file contents,
browsing, keystrokes, e-mail, passwords or clear-text
user names. Runs as a Windows service, systemd unit
or launchd daemon. Python standard library only.
signed roll-up on change, 15 min heartbeat
Linked company: no state machine of its own;
The only warranty authority. Monitoring never re-prices a bound
HTTPS POST /api/v1/enroll and /api/v1/report: TLS with a pinned CA, body signed HMAC-SHA256
POST /api/collector/rollup: one signed, sequenced fleet roll-up per linked company
200 response: the platform's warranty states, repricing_performed = false
